title: Invasion RTS UI Updates
author: Far_Rule5990
selftext:
Take a look at some new UI updates ive made to my game Invasion RTS

Ive been heavily invested in trying to make this games experience both attractive and enjoyable, although the game isnt for those that want an easy win.

4X RTS Hybrid - more details on my page!

Ive developed several agents to assist with production, economics, squad deployments and governors to assist with resource planning and distribution.

Civilians even have a life of their own, from the time they are birthed by "Mother" the synthetic growth chambers society has come to know and depend on for the future
